[E13] (bear) ROE is 4.4%. | value: 4.4% | source: filed statements This evidence suggests that Escorp Asset Management Ltd has a significantly lower return on equity compared to its sector benchmark, which implies potential underperformance and risk for investors. This weakens the case for a positive valuation based on historical performance metrics and suggests caution in valuing the stock at current levels.
